_about: Plain-language exercise texts (Nov 16 2026). Applied over exercises.json by buildSeed, so `npm run seed` keeps them. Tempo: the first movement the lifter makes comes first; lifting 1 s, lowering 3 s.

setup: Chest on the pad, feet flat, arms straight.
form: Shoulders back first, then elbows to your hips.
Hold at the top.
Lower until your arms are straight and shoulder blades spread.
tips: Elbows close: more lats. Elbows wide: more upper back.
t-bar-reverse-row.rangeOfMotion: Arms straight → elbows just past your body
t-bar-reverse-row.tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

single-arm-cable-lat-pulldown.why: Lats stretched, one arm at a time.
setup: Pulley high. Kneel or sit facing it, arm straight up.
form: Pull your elbow down to your side.
Go back up to the full stretch, hold.
tips: Pull with the elbow, not the hand.
single-arm-cable-lat-pulldown.rangeOfMotion: Arm straight up → elbow at your side
single-arm-cable-lat-pulldown.tempo: Down 1 s · Up 3 s · Hold 1 s

setup: Hand and knee on a bench, back flat.
Dumbbell hangs below your shoulder.
form: Pull your elbow back to your hip, not your chest.
Lower until your shoulder blade spreads forward.
avoid: Turning your body to lift more.
single-arm-db-row.rangeOfMotion: Arm hanging → dumbbell at your hip

setup: Pulley high, bar or rope.
Step back, lean forward a little.
form: Arms almost straight, pull down in an arc to your thighs. Squeeze.
tips: A rope lets your hands go past your hips.
straight-arm-cable-pulldown.rangeOfMotion: Arms up → hands at your thighs

db-incline-curl.why: Arms hang behind you: biceps stretched.
setup: Bench at 45–60°, head and shoulders on it.
Arms hanging straight, palms forward.
form: Curl up.
Lower until your arms are straight.

barbell-preacher-curl.why: Biceps work hardest near the bottom.
setup: Armpits at the top of the pad, upper arms flat on it.
EZ bar if a straight bar hurts your wrists.
form: Curl up, stop just before your forearms are upright.
Lower until your arms are almost straight.
tips: Go slowest near the bottom.
avoid: Dropping fast at the bottom (hard on the elbows).
barbell-preacher-curl.rangeOfMotion: Arms almost straight → forearms almost upright

setup: Seat so the handles start at chin height.
Back flat on the pad.
form: Push up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower to chin height.

cable-lateral-raise.why: Side delts, loaded the whole way.
setup: Pulley low, cable in front of you.
Stand tall, free hand on the machine.
form: Start with your hand across your body (stretch).
Raise out to shoulder height, elbow leading.
Lower all the way back across.
tips: Push your hand out wide, not up.
cable-lateral-raise.rangeOfMotion: Hand across your body → shoulder height

lateral-shrug-hybrid.why: Heavy traps: small side raise plus a shrug.
setup: Heavy dumbbells at your sides. Straps if your grip fails first.
form: Raise your arms out a little while shrugging up to your ears.
Hold at the top.
tips: Shoulders to ears matters, not arm height.
avoid: Turning it into a light side raise.
lateral-shrug-hybrid.rangeOfMotion: Arms at your sides → small raise with a full shrug
lateral-shrug-hybrid.tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

setup: Bar in front, hands just outside your thighs. Stand tall.
Straps so your grip doesn't fail first.
form: Shrug straight up, hold.
Lower all the way down.
barbell-shrug.tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

overhead-trap.why: Lower traps, which work hardest overhead.
setup: Cable on the lowest setting.
Stand 3–4 feet away.
form: Raise your arm in a big arc over your head.
Finish in a Y, slightly in front of your head, thumb up.
Reach up high and hold at the top.
tips: Go light enough to reach the top every rep.
overhead-trap.rangeOfMotion: Hand by your side → arm straight overhead
overhead-trap.tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

setup: Chest on the pad, handles at shoulder height.
Elbows slightly bent.
form: Open your arms back until in line with your body.
tips: Don't squeeze your shoulder blades hard together.
machine-reverse-fly.rangeOfMotion: Arms in front → arms in line with your body

setup: Bar on your upper back.
Feet shoulder width, under or a little in front of the bar.
form: Sit down until your thighs are level, no deeper.
Stand up through the middle of your feet.
tips: Feet more under the bar: more quads.
smith-squat.rangeOfMotion: Standing → thighs level with the floor

setup: Backrest all the way back, lean back against it.
Knees at the seat edge, lined up with the pivot.
Pad just above your ankles.
form: Straighten your legs, squeeze.
tips: Leaning back stretches the front of the thigh more.
avoid: Kicking up and letting it drop.
leg-extension.tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

setup: Face down, knees just past the pad edge.
Pad just above your heels.
form: Curl your heels to your butt, hold.
Lower until almost straight.
prone-leg-curl.tempo: Up 1 s · Hold 1 s · Down 3 s

setup: Sit tall, pads inside your knees.
Start as wide as you can control.
form: Squeeze your legs together, hold.
Open back to the stretch.
tips: The wide part does the most. Don't cut it short.
hip-adduction.tempo: In 1 s · Hold 1 s · Out 3 s

setup: Balls of your feet on the edge, knees straight.
form: Lower your heels all the way, pause.
Rise as high as you can.
tips: The pause at the bottom matters most.
standing-calf-raise.rangeOfMotion: Heels all the way down → all the way up
standing-calf-raise.tempo: Down 3 s · Hold 2 s · Up 1 s

setup: Hands a bit wider than your shoulders.
Thighs under the pad, lean back a little.
form: Pull the bar to your upper chest.
Go up until your arms are straight and shoulders rise (stretch).
wide-grip-lat-pulldown.rangeOfMotion: Arms straight up → bar at your upper chest

setup: Neutral handle, feet on the plate, knees slightly bent.
form: Row to your lower ribs, squeeze.
Let your arms go straight and shoulder blades spread.
tips: A small forward lean at the stretch is fine.
avoid: Leaning back or throwing it with your lower back.
cable-seated-row.rangeOfMotion: Arms straight → handle at your lower ribs
cable-seated-row.tempo: Pull 1 s · Hold 1 s · Return 3 s

setup: Bench at 30–45°.
Arms straight up, tilted slightly back.
form: Bend only your elbows, lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten back up.
ez-bar-incline-tricep-extension.rangeOfMotion: Bar behind your head → arms straight

setup: Back against the pad.
form: Push down until your arms are straight.
Come back up as deep as is comfortable.
avoid: Short reps that skip the deep part.

setup: Pulley high, V-bar.
Elbows at your sides, lean forward a little.
form: Push down until straight and squeeze.
Forearms come up just past level.
tips: The straight-arm squeeze is the point.

rope-face-pull.why: Rear delts and upper back. Good for shoulder health.
setup: Rope at face height.
form: Pull to your forehead, pulling the rope apart.
Finish with hands beside your ears, elbows high, hold.
tips: Light and controlled.
rope-face-pull.rangeOfMotion: Arms straight → hands beside your ears
rope-face-pull.tempo: Pull 1 s · Hold 1 s · Return 3 s

lean-away-lateral-raise.why: Leaning away gives a longer range of motion.
setup: Pulley low. Hold the machine, lean away 15–30°.
Handle in the other hand.
form: Start with your hand across your body.
Raise to shoulder height, lower.
tips: Start each rep from a full stop.
lean-away-lateral-raise.rangeOfMotion: Hand across your body → shoulder height

all-the-way-up-lateral-raise.why: Side delts to shoulder height, then traps above.
setup: Lighter dumbbells than a normal side raise.
form: Raise out to the sides, past shoulder height, almost overhead.
all-the-way-up-lateral-raise.rangeOfMotion: Arms at your sides → almost overhead

setup: Chest on the T-bar row pad, arms straight.
form: Squeeze your shoulder blades together, hold.
Let them go forward.
tips: Short move. Make the squeeze count.
kelso-shrug.tempo: Back 1 s · Hold 1 s · Forward 3 s

setup: Pulley at shoulder height.
Far hand on the handle, across your body.
form: Swing out and back at shoulder height, elbow slightly bent.
Return across.
tips: Shoulder down, body still.
single-arm-cable-reverse-fly.rangeOfMotion: Arm across your body → in line with your body

setup: Face away from the cable.
Rope behind your head, elbows forward by your ears.
form: Straighten your arms overhead.
Lower into a deep stretch.
rope-overhead-tricep-extension.rangeOfMotion: Hands behind your head → arms straight

db-hammer-curl.why: Heavy curl, palms in. Thicker arms.
setup: Palms facing in, elbows at your sides.
form: Curl one arm at a time to your shoulder.
Lower all the way.
tips: Add weight at 10 clean reps on every set.

setup: Feet low on the platform, shoulder width (more quads).
form: Lower until your knees are at about 90°.
Push back up.
avoid: Going so deep your lower back rounds.

setup: Lap pad tight, knees lined up with the pivot.
form: Curl all the way, hold.
tips: Lean forward for a bigger stretch.
avoid: Letting the weight yank your legs straight.
seated-leg-curl.tempo: Curl 1 s · Hold 1 s · Straighten 3 s

setup: Knees bent, pad on your thighs.
form: Lower your heels all the way, pause.
Rise as high as you can.
seated-calf-raise.rangeOfMotion: Heels all the way down → all the way up
seated-calf-raise.tempo: Down 3 s · Hold 2 s · Up 1 s

setup: Pulley low, lean forward.
Upper arm at your side, level with the floor.
form: Straighten your arm, squeeze.
Bend back to about 90°.
tips: Go light. The squeeze is the point.
cable-one-arm-tricep-kickback.tempo: Straighten 1 s · Hold 1 s · Bend 3 s
